svg.text: SNAKE ROWS OF 10, READ BY COLUMNS: THE MESSAGE PLACES IN THEIR GRID CELLS
Column 1 holds 10 cells, so the reading reaches column 2 at
letter 11. Place 22 is row 3 of column 2: letter 10 + 3 = 13.
With a secret word after the move, place 22's E must turn into
the copper's B in slot 13 mod p.
